about.text: A semi-cooked mixed caciotta from the Tuscia area of Viterbo, a traditional product (PAT), made from cow’s milk with up to half sheep’s milk. The milk is pasteurised and set with calf or lamb rennet, the curd is moulded and stoved, and the cheese is ripened from 20 days to 3 months.
